sources.license: Facts summarized from a public GitHub issue/PR; short error excerpt quoted.

symptom: @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = RANDOM_PORT) fails with PortInUseException / "Web server failed to start. Port 18081 was already in use" when management.server.port is a fixed port and that port is occupied, for example by a locally running instance of the app.
cause: In Boot 4 the random-port handling moved from SpringBootTestRandomPortEnvironmentPostProcessor to a listener, but the event is published before the context customizer registers that listener. RANDOM_PORT is therefore applied to server.port only and the management server keeps its configured fixed port.
fixSummary: In the test environment set management.server.port=0, for example in src/test/resources/config/application.properties (overrides the main config without touching test code) or via @SpringBootTest(properties = ...). Do not set it to -1: that disables the management server and local.management.port is no longer available. Fixed upstream in 4.0.2.
